source_data.dimension_notes: Type L is the middle D8+ Series JJ/L/LL column, not the F column. D+F gives 582 mm horizontal envelope; I+J gives 321 mm end width; A=472 mm is the inner hook span. Adding H=30 mm at each hook end yields an estimated 532 mm outer hook envelope; confirm datum interpretation before precise clearance modeling. Values describe one reeving pose only and are not a structural/rigging model.
